description: Use when the person wants jobs or their best matches: 'find me jobs', 'my top matches', 'remote marketing jobs that fit my resume', 'what's new for me this week'. It already uses the saved CV, so there is no need to read the profile first. Live vacancies matched to this account's CV, ranked. Each job carries a calibrated match percentage, a recruiter-pass verdict with a one-line reason, and whether an application was already sent. Filter by match tier and freshness; page with offset.

applied.description: hide = leave out jobs already applied to.

fresh.description: new = posted in the last two weeks; all = the last month.

match.description: Match tier. 'all' includes weak matches the recruiter pass rejected.

sort.description: fit = best match first; fresh = newest day first, best match within it.

name: list_matching_jobs
title: Jobs that match my CV right now
